chapter: Return to New Orleans and Sharkey
title: Playing on the Capitol riverboat and as a teen
summary: He played the Capitol with Almerico and as a teen on the boat with Fate Marable and others.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: That's a special. Oh, you mentioned the Capitol. You played on the Capitol with different bands?

No, just with Tony Almerico. I played, you know, but a long time ago when I was 17 years old, 15, 16, 17 years old, I played on the boat, you know, two bands, they had two bands, a colored band, you know, Marble?

Fade Marble. And the extra band, uh, that, uh, it used to be that, uh, you had a club and you'd hire, you know, extra bands to play that. And then, uh, it would be continuous dancing. That's when I was a kid.
But you don't remember whose band it was?
I played with Dan Hughes, uh, Jack Lane, and different bands like that. All bands, your shilling used to play on the boat. They had all kinds of bands that played on the boat.
